notes: Family release covering Qwen2.5 LLMs (0.5B-72B), Qwen2.5-Coder, Qwen2.5-Math, plus API models Qwen-Plus/Qwen-Turbo and an updated Qwen2-VL-72B. Release date: article:published_time metadata 2024-09-19T00:00:04+08:00 on qwenlm.github.io (page prints no human-readable date). This file intentionally overlaps legacy/qwen2-5-72b.json, which carries 8 evidence rows but no release_date and only covers the 72B slice; the precise date and the Coder/Math family coverage live here per the gap-filling instruction. Family-level prose claims ('MMLU: 85+', 'HumanEval 85+', 'MATH 80+') describe the Qwen2.5 generation as a whole without naming a single model, so they are recorded as cross-checks in row notes rather than standalone rows. All numeric values render inside seven images; rows are pending with vision-assisted reads in notes only (goal.md 12.5), except the Qwen2.5-Math-72B prose claim (verified + not_extracted). Images not transcribed (out of scope for rows, listed for completeness): Qwen2.5-72B base-model leaderboard scatter, Qwen-Plus instruct table, Qwen2.5-32B/Qwen-Turbo table, small-model MMLU-vs-size scatter, and the specification image. 72B table columns: Qwen2.5-72B Instruct | Qwen2-72B Instruct | Mistral-Large2 Instruct | Llama3.1-70B Instruct | Llama3.1-405B Instruct. Coder table columns: Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct | DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct | DeepSeek-Coder-33B-Instruct | CodeStral-22B | DeepSeek-Coder-6.7B-Instruct. No protocol footnotes anywhere on the page - shots/sampling undisclosed, a hallmark of 2024-era release posts.
